subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad issue remain open as the canonical umbrella until the chosen Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention PR lands, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining issue now?
rationale: The recovery carriers are implemented on main, but prevention changes provider replay semantics and multiple open PRs propose different scopes; automation cannot safely choose the permanent Anthropic replay contract.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until a prevention PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Move Canonical Tracking
options.body: Close this issue only after making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the explicit canonical prevention tracker and linking the still-open PRs there.

options.title: Defer Prevention
options.body: Treat current recovery as sufficient for now and intentionally defer provider replay-prevention policy to a later review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a prevention PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the maintainer-facing split between landed recovery and remaining create-side evidence in this issue discussion.
